newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania crime ring linked to murder rounded up.
newsitem.headline: Albania crime ring linked to murder rounded up.

text.p: Albanian police arrested members of a crime ring suspected of killing a senior justice official in Tirana last July, Albanian television reported on Tuesday.
"Police uncovered a terrorist organisation, members of which were also the killers of (director general of prisons) Bujar Kaloshi," the interior ministry said in a statement.
Police found an arsenal of arms belonging to the organisation and identified other members of the group and its ringleaders, the statement added.
Kaloshi, 40, died when six bullets were fired at him through the front window of his vehicle.
Organised crime appeared to be on the rise in Albania. Apart from a number of gangland killings, a police chief was shot dead and two policemen were killed in an ambush in the last few months.
